This movie has been described as Death Wish: UK edition but its a bit deeper than that. The tl;dw is an old guy gets fed up with punk criminal kids these days and starts shooting them. Probably a better comparison than Death Wish is Gran Torino (great movie btw).

Michael Caine plays Michael Caine (as usual) but he feels believable as a decrepit retired military guy who doesn't want to talk about his past. And his sad old guy expressions contrasted with the cartoon character chavs makes it easy to empathize with his actions.

The cinematography emphasizes the bleak cityscape where movie takes place making the estate as much of a character as any of the actors.

What I liked is the humanization vulnerability of the protagonist turning the story closer to a morality play than a power fantasy fulfillment plot.

Worth watching? Yes
